$comment: Shape of every entry in every rules file. Nothing enters a tool that does not have all of these fields filled.
statement: The rule in one plain sentence, as a tool would express it.
value: number, string, array or object. null where the rule is qualitative.
unit: percent | eur | days | months | km_h | null

source.name: Publisher, e.g. BOE consolidated text, AEAT sede electronica
source.ref: Law and article, e.g. art. 27 Ley 58/2003 (LGT)
source.url: The exact page that was read
source.source_dated: The consolidation or publication date shown on that page

review_by: ISO date. After this the tool must show the figure as needing review.
notes: Anything a developer would otherwise get wrong.
